About this certificate
What is a sick leave certificate?

A sick leave certificate is an official medical document issued by a certified doctor. It confirms that you were medically unfit to attend work, classes or your regular responsibilities for a specific period.
Employers and institutions use it to verify genuine medical absences and keep accurate attendance records.

Check these details before you submit. Incomplete certificates may be delayed or rejected by employers or institutions.

Avoid fake certificates. A genuine certificate is issued only after a real health assessment by a qualified doctor. Certificate generators and edited templates can be rejected and may cause problems with your employer or institution.

What do employers, schools or airlines usually expect from an online sick leave certificate?

Most employers and schools expect a certificate that names you, gives the dates you were unfit, and shows the doctor's name and registration. Rules differ by employer, institution, airline and country.

Singapore gives a clear example. The Ministry of Manpower says employees covered by the Employment Act get paid sick leave after at least 3 months of service, up to 14 days outpatient and 60 days hospitalisation, with the full entitlement after 6 months. An employee who cannot report for work must inform the employer within 48 hours.

The medical certificate is then submitted on returning to work. To qualify for paid sick leave, the employee must be certified unfit for work by a medical practitioner registered under the Medical Registration Act or the Dental Registration Act.
Before applying, ask HR or your school office whether they accept online medical notes, whether they use their own form, and how long a period they accept on one note.

blocks.text: What does an online sick leave certificate include?
An online sick leave certificate from DrCertificate shows who you are, the period the doctor recommends you rest, and who issued it. Recipients usually check those three parts first.

Your full name appears as it is on your ID. The doctor's statement gives the dates you were unfit for work or study. For generic symptoms, sick leave notes in most South East Asian countries go up to 7 days.
The doctor's name, qualification and medical council registration details appear on the certificate. An employer or school can use them to check who signed it.

Which option should you choose on the form for an online sick leave certificate?
Choose Medical Certificate Sick Leave (For University/Work) on the form. The same option covers a general medical certificate.

In your answers, say who will receive the certificate, for example your employer or university, and list your symptoms with the date they started. If no option fits, email care@drcertificate.com before you pay.
What will the doctor ask you for an online sick leave certificate?
The doctor will ask what symptoms you have, when they started and which dates you need the certificate to cover. Clear, honest answers help the doctor reach a decision quickly.

Expect questions about how the illness affects your daily tasks, any medicine you have taken and past health problems that matter. A pharmacy receipt, a thermometer reading or an earlier clinic note can help if you have one.
The doctor may send follow-up questions in the chat. Reply promptly, because a stalled chat slows the review. Your name must match your ID, and your symptoms must fit the dates you request.
Where can an online sick leave certificate not be used?
An online sick leave certificate from DrCertificate cannot be submitted in India, used for legal purposes or used for insurance. Applicants must be at least 16 years old.

The service is for suitable non emergency situations only. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding or any symptom that feels severe, go to your nearest emergency department or call your local emergency number now.
Acceptance is up to the recipient. Check with your employer or school before you apply.
What happens if the doctor cannot issue your online sick leave certificate?
If the doctor cannot issue your online sick leave certificate, you receive no certificate and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2% of requests.

Declines happen when details are wrong, for example when the name and ID do not match, or when the symptoms and details you share are inconsistent. A doctor will also decline when your condition needs an in person examination or tests that a chat cannot replace. In that case, visit a local clinic or hospital.
Refunds apply only for a verified technical fault within 24 hours.
For help, email care@drcertificate.com.
What does an online sick leave certificate cost?
An online sick leave certificate costs 25 SGD in Singapore, 399 pesos in the Philippines and 30 MYR in Malaysia. The fee covers the doctor's review and, if approved, the PDF certificate.
Payment is through Stripe and is non refundable.

blocks.text: Will my employer, school or airline accept an online sick leave certificate?
Acceptance depends on your employer's or school's own policy, and no online certificate is accepted everywhere. DrCertificate encourages every customer to confirm with the recipient before applying.

All doctors on the platform are registered with a medical council. A recipient can verify the issuing doctor by checking the name and registration details on the certificate against that council's records. In Singapore, paid sick leave needs a practitioner registered under the Medical Registration Act, which makes asking HR first worth the effort.
If your employer or school requires its own form, a DrCertificate PDF will not replace it. Ask whether a doctor's certificate is acceptable in its place.
Online sick leave certificate vs related certificates: which do you need?

An online sick leave certificate says you were too unwell to work or study, while a work from home certificate says you can work but should stay home. Pick the row that matches what your recipient asked for, then choose the matching form option.

FAQs
Questions about sick leave certificates
What is an online Sick Leave Certificate?

An online Sick Leave Certificate is a digital document issued by a certified doctor (MBBS, MD or MS) that records your illness and recommends time off work or school. You apply without an in-person visit, and the doctor decides whether to issue it.
How quickly can I receive my Sick Leave Certificate?
It usually takes about 30 minutes. If the doctor approves your request, the certificate is sent to your email as a PDF.
Is the service available every day?
Yes, the service runs 365 days a year, including weekends and public holidays. A doctor reviews requests during working hours, so a request made outside those hours waits for the next working slot.
Can I get a Sick Leave Certificate in my local language?
A certificate in a local language is not promised. Email care@drcertificate.com to ask before you apply.
Who issues the online Sick Leave Certificate?
A certified doctor (MBBS, MD or MS) issues the certificate. The doctor works independently and alone decides whether to issue it and what it says. The certificate is not for submission in India.
How much does a certificate cost?

The price depends on your country, for example 25 SGD in Singapore, 399 pesos in the Philippines or 30 MYR in Malaysia. The application form shows the price before you pay. Payments are non-refundable, including when a doctor declines a request.
Are these certificates accepted by employers and institutions?
Acceptance depends on the organisation you submit it to, so check first. A certified doctor issues the certificate, so ask whether they accept that.
Can I obtain a Sick Leave Certificate on Public Holidays?
Yes, you can apply on a public holiday, because the service runs 365 days a year. A doctor reviews your request during working hours.
What if my employer or institution has specific format requirements?
Email care@drcertificate.com with the format before you apply, because a change of format is not guaranteed. Acceptance depends on the organisation you submit it to, so check first.
How long is an online sick leave certificate valid?

An online sick leave certificate covers the dates the doctor writes on it. In most South East Asian countries, sick leave notes go up to 7 days for generic symptoms. Your employer or school then decides whether that period meets its own leave rules.
Can a sick leave certificate be backdated?

A doctor certifies only the dates that fit the symptoms and timeline you report. You can describe an illness that began before you applied, and the doctor decides what period to state. Requests where the dates and symptoms do not match are declined, and the fee is not refunded.
How is the online sick leave certificate delivered?

Approved certificates arrive by email as a PDF, usually about 30 minutes after you apply. Check your spam folder if nothing appears. You can print the PDF or forward it to your employer, school or HR team, whichever your recipient prefers.
Can I correct my name or dates after the certificate is issued?

No, a certificate cannot be corrected once it is issued, unless the error came from the medical team. Type your name to match your ID and check your dates before you pay. If the medical team made the mistake, email care@drcertificate.com with your details.
Can I use the certificate in my country?

Yes, if you live in one of the 10 South East Asian countries DrCertificate serves and your recipient accepts online medical notes. The certificate is not for submission in India, for legal purposes or for insurance. Confirm acceptance with your employer or school first.
Is my health information kept private?

Your health details are shared with the doctor who reviews your request, for the purpose of that review. Give only the information the doctor needs to decide. For any question about how DrCertificate handles your data, email care@drcertificate.com before or after you apply.
Do I need a video call to get a sick leave certificate?

No, DrCertificate has no video or in person consultations. The doctor reviews your form and may ask follow-up questions by text chat. If the doctor feels your condition needs a physical examination or tests, the request is declined and you should visit a local clinic.
